map.grams per square meter，每平方米克重，是纸张定量的标准标称: Grams per square meter, the standard nominal basis weight of paper (such as 80gsm copier paper or 250gsm card stock). It indirectly reflects thickness and stiffness, but the same gsm with a different pulp or calendering process can still differ in thickness.

map.严格互算需知道纸张密度（ρ）：厚度 t=定量/(ρ×1000)，其中 ρ 约 0: An exact conversion needs the paper density ρ: thickness t = basis weight / (ρ x 1000), where ρ is about 0.6~0.9 g/cm³. The r = v x rate x f / t formula of this tool folds the density into rate, which suits quick conversion within a product family; across families (coated vs lightweight paper) the density differs, so measured values still rule.

map.设计选材时在克重与厚度间换算，平衡挺度、手感与印刷适性（厚纸挺但贵、薄纸省但软）: When selecting materials, convert between basis weight and thickness to balance stiffness, hand feel and print suitability (thick paper is stiff but expensive, thin paper saves material but is soft).
map.采购时把不同标称（定量 gsm 或厚度 μm/μm 当量）的纸张统一到可比口径，: When purchasing, unify papers with different nominal bases (basis weight gsm or thickness in μm/μm equivalent) onto a comparable basis and account for the cost per unit area.
map.：按 r = v×rate×f/t 计算：150×0.8×1/2 = 60。该式: : compute r = v x rate x f / t: 150x0.8x1/2 = 60. This formula is the skeleton of general unit conversion — v is the original value, rate is the dimensional coefficient (such as a density ratio), and f/t is the ratio of the source unit to the target unit. For example converting gsm into an equivalent expressed in a reference thickness, or the reverse, just means picking the right f and t, without memorizing the density of every paper.
